{
  "name": "spark-workflow-frontend",
  "description": "React frontend for the SPARK Workflow application.",
  "license": "EUPL-1.2",
  "private": true,
  "packageManager": "pnpm@10.30.2",
  "type": "module",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=24 <25",
    "pnpm": "10.30.2"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "build": "vite build && tsc",
    "check": "pnpm run \"/^check:.*/\"",
    "check:lint": "pnpm exec eslint --fix && pnpm exec prettier --write --log-level error .",
    "check:test": "pnpm exec vitest run --reporter=agent",
    "check:types": "pnpm run type-check",
    "dev": "vite",
    "dev:port-forwarding": "node src/scripts/validate-port-forwarding-env.js && VITE_DEV_API_MODE=port-forwarding vite --port 3000",
    "format": "prettier --write .",
